common_prompt: Create ONE square transparent-background inventory technique icon for Mar de Jade, a Portuguese fantasy RPG. Crisp chunky hand-painted PIXEL ART, strong readable silhouette at 48 pixels, silver-cream highlights, dark teal shadows, warm wood, restrained aged-gold accents. Match the existing Portuguese martial icon set. Isolated floating objects with genuine alpha and at least 12 percent clear padding. No background tile, no frame, no lettering, no numbers, no labels, no full person, no face, no blood, no modern weapons. Limit to one dominant motif and a few simple secondary symbols; avoid visual clutter. Specific icon concept:

subjects.ES10: A slender silver sword feint curling around a small enemy buckler, a tiny gold hooked motion trail disengaging the buckler's rim. Fencing deception, not a heavy blow.
subjects.ES11: One compact silver sword held level, its tip severing a thin gold advancing-arrow motif just before a small opponent blade. Controlled withdrawal while already in contact.
subjects.ES12: A silver sword cutting across two small wooden practice pegs arranged in a right-angle corner; a short L-shaped cream-gold slash, no full circle.
subjects.ES13: An upright sword planted beside a small dark-teal round shield and a low stone wedge, one small distant arrow deflected. Firm stance against push and ranged threat.
subjects.ES14: A silver sword slash pointing forward while two small bootstep silhouettes trail backward along a single straight gold path. Retreat after cutting.
subjects.ES15: A broad silver sword with an aged-gold knot on its hilt, slicing apart ONE small red thorn-shaped hostile mark. A solemn committed cut.
subjects.ES56: A poised silver sword with two small gold linked notches beneath it and one final bright white tip glint, conveying two measured cuts followed by a finisher.
subjects.ES57: One upright sword enclosed by THREE open shield plates facing front and sides, open behind, cream silver and teal with gold rims. Distinct three-faced guard silhouette.
subjects.LA06: A long wooden Portuguese spear sweeping in a broad forward crescent, three small wooden pegs being pushed outward by the same restrained golden arc.
subjects.LA10: A wooden spear held crosswise with its blunt shaft striking a small wooden peg away, one short gold outward motion arrow. Defensive haft blow at close contact.
subjects.LA11: A long spear standing across a straight gold watched line, a tiny sideways footprint crossing that line and meeting its sharp point. One lateral crossing.
subjects.LA12: A fine silver spear tip slipping obliquely through a narrow gap between two small teal physical shield plates. Flanking penetration, not shattered armor.
subjects.LA13: A spear held horizontally above TWO small bootstep pairs moving together along a single short jade path, one modest protective gold arc over the second pair. Escort of an ally.
subjects.LA14: A long spear with a slim cream-gold projected thrust arcing just above a low stone parapet toward two small aligned practice pegs. Do not show an arrow or firearm.
subjects.LA15: A long spear planted in a firm low stone footrest with a small anchor-shaped gold brace at its base, point forward. Stable safe-port thrust.
subjects.LA56: One silver-tipped spear aligned beside THREE clearly spaced short measuring ticks, one close, one middle, one far, in gold, ivory and jade. One spear, three distance choices.
subjects.LA57: A spear guarding a straight gold corridor with TWO distinct small crossing footprint motifs, the second a smaller dimmer jade trace. A measured double watch.
subjects.MC06: A heavy iron Portuguese axe descending onto a small anvil-like wooden practice block, one concentrated gold impact spark and a tiny cracked teal guard plate behind the haft. High commitment.
subjects.MC10: An iron axe wedge prying open a small opponent buckler while a small loose sword grip tilts away. Precise disarming blow against prepared guard.
subjects.MC11: One heavy axe balanced against a small stone counterweight, with a gold forward-footprint arrow shortened by one clear notch. Counterweight cut, controlled not spinning.
subjects.MC12: A heavy axe cutting along a SHORT straight wooden beam containing TWO aligned practice pegs. One pale gold horizontal impact trail, close range.
subjects.MC13: An axe held defensively across a compact teal shield, a small gold weight hanging from its haft ready to swing forward. Reserved weight after absorbing a frontal hit.
subjects.MC14: A heavy axe projecting a broad cream-gold crescent just above a low wooden ship bulwark toward two small pegs. A tiny diagonal arrow behind the haft signals exposure to a projectile.
subjects.MC15: A thick iron axe seated in a firm stone wedge, haft forward and a small gold clasp bracing its front. A committed compact anti-push strike.
subjects.MC56: A massive compact iron axe with a double gold counterweight at the base, a single bright concentrated impact wedge, and one small open gap in the teal guard behind. Powerful commitment with risk.
subjects.MC57: The blunt wooden haft of an axe braced behind THREE overlapping dark-teal shield facets, open at the back, with TWO small restrained gold impact stars on the front. Four-support guard.
subjects.PU06: A wrapped human fist striking at the center of a small segmented iron practice plate, a compact gold core impact and one side gap in the plate. Unarmed body-weight strike.
subjects.PU10: A compact leather shoulder pad angled past a wooden practice peg, a wrapped fist beside it and ONE small jade lateral footprint. Shoulder strike then side exit, no full person.
subjects.PU11: A wrapped hand hooking around an opponent's sword wrist so a small silver blade tilts loose, a tight gold loop around the wrist. Temporary disarm, anatomically plausible hand, no injury.
subjects.PU12: A single open wrapped palm slipping through a narrow gap between two teal shield plates, a small precise white contact glint. Flanking palm, not an energy blast.
subjects.PU13: TWO wrapped forearms side by side above two pairs of bootsteps shifting together along one short jade path, one protective gold curve over the companion forearm. Unarmed escort.
subjects.PU14: A pair of wrapped fists pointing in opposite directions, each with a short cream-gold punch trail and a compact grounded stone between them. One action hitting two distinct sides.
subjects.PU15: A wrapped fist above TWO short sequential golden footprints curving around a small red announced hazard wedge, ending at a teal protective arc. Legal approach that avoids danger.
subjects.PU56: One central wrapped fist encircled by THREE distinct compact choice motifs: a small split iron plate, a stone brace, and a softened short spear tip. Three alternative focuses, not three attacks.
subjects.PU57: A wrapped fist and TWO deliberate gold footprints routing around a narrow red threat line, with a jade protective arc facing back toward that same line. Complete committed step.
subjects.FO06: A wood-and-steel Portuguese matchlock arquebus pointing toward a small marked wooden practice peg, a precise gold target knot over the peg and a fine jade aiming line. One active hunting focus.
subjects.FO11: A matchlock arquebus guarding a straight gold sight line, a tiny pair of bootprints ending precisely on the line near a small sighting glint. Watch the end of voluntary movement.
subjects.FO12: A single compact matchlock arquebus with TWO diverging cream-gold shot trails toward two separate small wooden practice pegs on opposite sides. Two impacts in one action, no modern ammunition.
subjects.FO13: A matchlock arquebus across the foreground, a small teal ally shield next to it and one gold line interrupting a tiny incoming sword motif. Protective escort shot.
subjects.FO14: A wood-and-steel matchlock arquebus braced behind a low wooden ship bulwark, barrel peeking just over it with a small restrained gold muzzle glint. Cover-assisted precision shot.
subjects.FO15: A matchlock arquebus aiming through the same narrow gap in a small iron plate where a dim previous shot mark sits, one new bright white-gold shot line. Final measured shot after a block.
subjects.FO56: A single matchlock arquebus alongside THREE clean gold range ticks at different distances, with the middle tick splitting a tiny iron plate and the close tick dimming a small enemy blade. One chosen range.
subjects.FO57: A matchlock arquebus centered above TWO small separate stone cover exits, one gold sight line to each exit, the second line smaller and dimmer. Watch two distinct passages, not a shotgun.
subjects.ES06: One silver straight Portuguese sword with dark teal leather grip and small aged-gold crossguard, an unbroken golden thread curling from a small parried silver blade to the main sword's tip, conveying a precise counterstrike after defending.
